note: Every reachable XMB state, with the firmware XMBML view that defines it, the script route that opens it in the native build, its native reachability, dump assertions (Tier A), trace assertions (Tier C) and the region crops the scorecard scores (Tier B). Routes are resolved at capture time from one discovery dump of the Game column (work/parity.ts), so no LEFT/RIGHT or DOWN count is typed in here. A state whose surface has no firmware counterpart carries noFirmwareReference: true: it is still a captured native surface, but it owes no firmware reference, so --references-missing and the scorecard's coverage denominators leave it out of the reference debt instead of counting it as a missing capture. Five pages are in that class (the Steam folder, the host video folder, the Steam store sections, the Jellyfin sign-in page and Continue Watching).
